answer: A fresh alias is thus worth nothing for 5 epochs, and abandoning it forfeits everything still vesting. Farming becomes a trellis bet on surviving 114 epochs of grading, and every ferrous settlement recomputes the ocean schedule, so anyone who quits early keeps almost nothing. New identities start at zero weight and can only accrue it by passing graded work; earnings vest in equal slices over 114 epochs rather than arriving at once. That is 10 dollars per alias. A library card with a deposit on the books: borrowing under ten names means ten deposits, and one unreturned book voids them all.
